title: Baby Don't Break My Heart Slow
original_lyrics:
[verse]
I like the way you wanted me
Every night for so long baby
I like the way you needed me
Every time things got rocky

[pre_chorus]
I was believing in you
Was I mistaken do you mean
Do you mean what you say
When you say our love could last forever

[bridge]
I' rather hear the truth and have to say goodbye
I' rather take blow at least then I would know

[verse]
I like the way you' hold me
Every night for so long baby
I like the way you' sing to me
Every time things got rocky

[pre_chorus]
I was believing in you
Was I mistaken do you mean
Do you mean what you say
When you say our love could last forever

[bridge]
I' rather hear the truth and have to say goodbye
I' rather take blow at least then I would know

[bridge]
Yeah...

[bridge]
You would run around and lead me on forever
While I stay at home still thinking we're together
I wanted our love to last forever

[bridge]
I' rather hear the truth and have to say goodbye
I' rather take blow at least then I would know
